authority.scope: one live project, no restart or model requests
authority.pane_evidence: not collected; user chose disk-log analysis only

findings.finding: CCB recovery creates a cross-provider startup dependency
findings.evidence: sync_daemon refuses to start the restored daemon until all previously mounted actors are bound. Pi's bridge identity was available at 10:13:15.666, Codex server began at 10:13:17.073.
findings.limit: The first 9.005 seconds include recovery checks, namespace work and provider binding; no per-operation trace exists to allocate every millisecond.

findings.finding: Model catalog cache version mismatch forces online refresh
evidence: 10:13:18.383: expected 0.162.1, cached 0.162.0; no usable cache entry
10:13:24.285: cache had changed back to 0.162.0; no usable cache entry
findings.limit: Same-path cache version churn is proven. The process that wrote the 0.162.0 entry was not positively attributed.

findings.finding: UI rendering is not the main measured delay
findings.evidence: TUI initial-frame log: duration_ms=964, bootstrap_ms=930, thread_and_widget_ms=23, initial_session_ms=6, event_stream_ms=0. Reusing running thread, not a second full model session startup.
findings.limit: Initial-frame scheduling is not an observed interactive-ready timestamp.

findings.finding: New coordination config/read is small relative to total
findings.evidence: config/read request at 10:13:18.167, thread/resume request at 10:13:18.323: about 156 ms including transport/control-loop work.

checks.replay_verdict: Codex TUI process >5s after Pi: reproduced
checks.query_mode: SQLite read-only, exact runtime PIDs and bounded timestamps

recommended_next_steps: Split provider prewarming from durable-job admission during recovery; retain full recovery barriers for dispatch and callbacks.
Resolve mixed-version shared model-cache churn without copying whole provider homes or deleting shared cache.
Add bounded per-stage startup durations so future regressions can be attributed without raw payload logs.
excluded_claims: No evidence that a slow model response caused startup delay; no model task was sent.
No evidence that disabling all plugins or replacing PowerShell is needed.
No performance improvement claimed; this task diagnosed the existing startup.
